outcome: Utilization of specialized health care services (number of outpatient visits, number of inpatient treatment episodes, duration of inpatient days)
cohort: The study included 55,719 singleton children born in Finland in 2009, with 6,235 (11.1%) exposed to maternal GDM and 49,484 unexposed children.
finding: Children exposed to maternal GDM had a higher incidence of outpatient visits and were more likely to require inpatient treatment compared to unexposed children, with increased utilization observed across all age categories up to 12 years.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as an adjustment factor, but no specific findings related to mode of birth were reported.
